title: ドラゴンクエストV 天空の花嫁
title_romaji: Dragon Quest V: Tenkuu no Hanayome
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots
The characters read off the pictures the game drew for them in play, each code paired with the glyph drawn the frame it left the game's queue
Played from power-on through the opening; the script's readings compared with the lines read off 5 pictures, and read through for 17 messages
notes: Read by the script games/sfc/SFC-F061BF93.lua; there is no layout. The game keeps no line of text, but unpacks its messages ahead into a queue of 16-bit codes, which the script reads. The table holds only the 81 characters met in the opening; the rest come out as U+FFFD. The hero's name inside a message, menus, battle messages and shops aren't read.
